operation.summary: Hand the phone an action manifest once: any action it can take (any /v1 call you're allowed, plus download, play, show, send and delete of saved files), each with its own schedule. The owner approves each new manifest once on the phone; then it runs by itself and results arrive as schedule.* events

body.name: manifest
body.description: {timezone?, actions:[{id, name?, when, do, save_as?, send_to?}]} (see GET /v1/guide → schedule)

body.name: url
body.description: Instead of manifest: a public https:// URL the phone polls for the manifest (ETag honoured)

body.name: poll_minutes
body.description: With url: how often to check, 15-1440 (default 60)

operation.returns: status (awaiting_owner, or active when identical to the running manifest), digest, actions[{id, summary}]

manifest.description: {timezone?, actions:[{id, name?, when, do, save_as?, send_to?}]} (see GET /v1/guide → schedule)

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
